title: wizcontrol config.yaml
description: Schema for the YAML configuration used by wizcontrol. Matches the structure defined in pkg/wizcontrol/config/config.go.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name, for example America/Chicago.

evaluation_period.description: How often calendar entries are evaluated.

recheck_period.description: How often current light state is rechecked.

state_recovery_file.description: Optional path to a file used to persist state across restarts.

colors.description: Named colors referenced by scenes and calendar entries.

additionalProperties.description: A valid Wiz color definition such as #FF0000, W2700, or a dynamic scene string.

lights.description: Named lights keyed by friendly name. Values are IP addresses or MAC addresses.

light_groups.description: Named groups of light names used in scene definitions.

scenes.description: Named scenes containing one or more light targets and a color mapping.

calendar.description: Calendar entries that apply scenes conditionally by date and time.

duration.description: A Go time.Duration encoded as a YAML duration string or numeric nanoseconds.

broadcast_address.description: Broadcast IP used for Wiz discovery on multi-NIC systems.

url.description: MQTT broker URL, for example mqtt://host:1883.

allow_control.description: Whether MQTT clients may send control commands.

cert_chain.description: Path to the certificate chain for HTTPS.

key.description: Path to the private key for HTTPS.

targets.description: Names of lights or light groups that receive the scene color.

color.description: Name of a color defined in colors.

from.description: Start date, such as jan 1 or halloween - 10.

to.description: End date, such as dec 31 or easter_sunday + 2.

before.description: Optional time cutoff before which the entry is active.

after.description: Optional time cutoff after which the entry is active.

scenes.description: Scene names that the calendar entry applies.

mode.description: How a list of scenes is selected.

frequency.description: When mode is random or rotate, how often scenes should change.
